def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    order_items = db['order_items']
    orders = db['orders']
    reviews = db['reviews']

    entity_list = list(entity_ids)
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_list, dtype=float)

    feature_names = [
        'n_orders', 'n_items', 'total_sales', 'avg_price', 'std_price',
        'avg_freight', 'std_freight', 'n_sellers', 'days_since_first',
        'days_since_last', 'lifetime_days', 'has_sales',
        'avg_review_score', 'std_review_score', 'n_reviews',
        'n_orders_last_30', 'n_orders_last_60', 'n_orders_last_90',
        'n_orders_last_180', 'n_orders_last_365',
        'sales_last_30', 'sales_last_90',
        'trend_30_vs_90', 'trend_90_vs_365',
        'n_distinct_customers', 'avg_items_per_order',
        'avg_delivery_days', 'delivered_orders_ratio',
        'avg_review_score_last_90', 'n_reviews_last_90',
    ]
    for f in feature_names:
        features[f] = 0.0

    # Товары, проданные до seed_time (по дате покупки — это известная информация)
    mask = (order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_list)) & (order_items['ts'] <= seed_time)
    items = order_items.loc[mask].copy()

    if not items.empty:
        # ---- Базовые агрегаты по всей истории до seed_time ----
        agg = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
            n_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            n_items=('price', 'size'),
            total_sales=('price', 'sum'),
            avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
            std_price=('price', 'std'),
            avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            std_freight=('freight_value', 'std'),
            n_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
            n_customers=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            first_purchase=('ts', 'min'),
            last_purchase=('ts', 'max')
        )
        agg['days_since_first'] = (seed_time - agg['first_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - agg['last_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['lifetime_days'] = (agg['last_purchase'] - agg['first_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['has_sales'] = 1
        agg['avg_items_per_order'] = agg['n_items'] / agg['n_orders'].replace(0, np.nan)

        base_cols = [
            'n_orders', 'n_items', 'total_sales', 'avg_price', 'std_price',
            'avg_freight', 'std_freight', 'n_sellers', 'days_since_first',
            'days_since_last', 'lifetime_days', 'has_sales',
            'n_distinct_customers', 'avg_items_per_order'
        ]
        ren = {'n_customers': 'n_distinct_customers'}
        agg = agg.rename(columns=ren)
        for col in base_cols:
            if col in agg.columns:
                features.loc[agg.index, col] = agg[col]

        # ---- Окна по времени ----
        counts = items.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
        sales = items.groupby('product_id')['price'].sum()
        for period in [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=period)
            w = items[items['ts'] >= cutoff]
            wc = w.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
            features[f'n_orders_last_{period}'] = features[f'n_orders_last_{period}'].fillna(0.0)
            features.loc[wc.index, f'n_orders_last_{period}'] = wc
            if period == 30:
                ws = w.groupby('product_id')['price'].sum()
                features.loc[ws.index, 'sales_last_30'] = ws
            if period == 90:
                ws = w.groupby('product_id')['price'].sum()
                features.loc[ws.index, 'sales_last_90'] = ws

        c30 = features['n_orders_last_30']
        c90 = features['n_orders_last_90']
        c180 = features['n_orders_last_180']
        features['trend_30_vs_90'] = (c30 / c90.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)
        features['trend_90_vs_365'] = (c90 / features['n_orders_last_365'].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)

        # ---- Отзывы: только те, что созданы ДО seed_time ----
        rev = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time][['order_id', 'review_score']]
        uniq_orders = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
        rev_join = uniq_orders.merge(rev, on='order_id', how='inner')
        if not rev_join.empty:
            rev_agg = rev_join.groupby('product_id')['review_score'].agg(
                avg_review_score='mean', std_review_score='std', n_reviews='count'
            )
            for col in ['avg_review_score', 'std_review_score', 'n_reviews']:
                features.loc[rev_agg.index, col] = rev_agg[col]

            # Отзывы за последние 90 дней
            rev_recent = rev_join.merge(
                items[['product_id', 'order_id', 'ts']].drop_duplicates(),
                on=['product_id', 'order_id'], how='left'
            )
            rev_recent = rev_recent[rev_recent['ts'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
            if not rev_recent.empty:
                rr = rev_recent.groupby('product_id')['review_score'].agg(
                    avg_review_score_last_90='mean', n_reviews_last_90='count'
                )
                for col in ['avg_review_score_last_90', 'n_reviews_last_90']:
                    features.loc[rr.index, col] = rr[col]

        # ---- Доставка: только заказы, фактически доставленные до seed_time ----
        ord_cols = ['order_id', 'order_delivered_customer_date',
                    'order_estimated_delivery_date', 'order_purchase_timestamp']
        o = orders[ord_cols].copy()
        o = o[o['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() &
              (o['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)]
        if not o.empty:
            delivered = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates().merge(
                o, on='order_id', how='inner'
            )
            if not delivered.empty:
                delivered['delivery_days'] = (
                    delivered['order_delivered_customer_date'] -
                    delivered['order_purchase_timestamp']
                ).dt.days
                delivered['on_time'] = (
                    delivered['order_delivered_customer_date'] <=
                    delivered['order_estimated_delivery_date']
                ).astype(float)
                d_agg = delivered.groupby('product_id').agg(
                    avg_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'mean'),
                    delivered_orders=('order_id', 'nunique')
                )
                on_time = delivered.groupby('product_id')['on_time'].mean()
                for pid in d_agg.index:
                    n_ord = features.at[pid, 'n_orders']
                    if n_ord and n_ord > 0:
                        features.at[pid, 'avg_delivery_days'] = d_agg.at[pid, 'avg_delivery_days']
                        features.at[pid, 'delivered_orders_ratio'] = d_agg.at[pid, 'delivered_orders'] / n_ord

    features = features.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
    features = features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    features = features.reindex(entity_list)
    return features
